#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int compute_gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        int temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, limit;
    cin >> a >> b >> limit;
    int divisor = compute_gcd(a, b);
    a /= divisor;
    b /= divisor;
    if (limit >= b) {
        cout << a << "/" << b << "\n";
    } else {
        long double ratio = (long double)a / b;
        long double min_diff = ratio;
        int best_num = 0, best_den = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= limit; ++i) {
            long double val = i * ratio;
            long double floor_val = floor(val);
            long double diff1 = abs(floor_val / i - ratio);
            long double diff2 = abs((floor_val + 1) / i - ratio);
            if (min_diff > diff1 || min_diff > diff2) {
                if (diff1 > diff2) {
                    best_num = floor_val + 1;
                } else {
                    best_num = floor_val;
                }
                best_den = i;
                min_diff = min(diff1, diff2);
            }
        }
        cout << best_num << "/" << best_den;
    }
    return 0;
}
